title: Introducing Koyal - Plivo's text-to-speech model for voice AI agents
summary: Koyal is Plivo's own text-to-speech for voice agents: English, Spanish and 12 other Indian languages, under 200 ms to first audio, ₹0.65 ($0.0065) a minute.
body_markdown:
Today we’re launching Koyal, our first in-house text-to-speech model, built from the ground up for voice AI agents that need the lowest possible latency. Koyal speaks 14 languages including Assamese, Bengali, English, Gujarati, Hindi, Kannada, Malayalam, Marathi, Nepali, Odia, Punjabi, Spanish, Tamil and Telugu. It delivers its first audio in under 200 ms so that your voice agent can talk to every caller in their language, without a pause. Koyal costs $0.0065/min, or ₹0.65/min in India.


## Why we built Koyal


Plivo carries over 5 billion voice calls a year, and more of those calls are now answered by voice agents. We kept seeing teams run into the same three tradeoffs: text-to-speech that sounded good either had high latency, expensive, or shaky when it needed to switch languages. You could have quality, speed or price, but not all three.


## Performance


We ranked Koyal against leading text-to-speech models for latency and it’s competitive or better than most of the widely used models in various languages.

## Price


Koyal costs ₹0.65 a minute in India and $0.0065 a minute in the US. Koyal is hosted locally in India and the US. Your audio is processed and stays in the region you choose, which keeps latency low and helps you meet data residency rules. More regions and languages are coming soon.

Koyal is available to every Plivo account today. If you already run voice agents on LiveKit, Pipecat or your own stack, point your agent at Koyal; nothing else changes.
